candidate_state: planned from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, king-relative feature tests, default dependency isolation, opening-book feature tests, USI state-transition smoke, public-contract checks, WebAssembly Chrome tests, package generation, and a native USI smoke passed. The pre-registered material-only SEARCH_V2 gate passed and SEARCH_V2 plus V2_ROOT are enabled by default. The experimental continuation correction, quiet-promotion quiescence, V2-specific quiescence, and Lazy SMP vote controls remain disabled by default.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.60.

known_limitations: The accepted material-only SEARCH_V2 gate used one thread. The move-ordering tables were made searcher-local after that gate, and a post-fix four-thread match has not yet been run.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
No general playing-strength or external-engine superiority claim is made for this release.
No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
